title: Melissa Time Classic (Smurf edition)
desc: The original Smurf version of Melissa's 54th birthday game: rescue the Smurfs from Gargamel's Castle and find all 54 candles.

title: Peter's Pecker Sword Fight
desc: Adults only, 18+. Crude party humor: 8 games. Sword fights, a pool-deck duel, Pecker Sumo, a piñata, ring toss, a pool float joust, pin the pecker and limbo. Passcode on the game too.

title: Taco Strike: Totally 80s
desc: A walking taco storms the 80s Saturday-morning lands: Rainbow Brite, the Care Bears, She-Ra, G.I. Joe vs Cobra, Endor speeder bikes, the Ewok village, Jabba's Sarlacc pit, an X-wing trench run and the Millennium Falcon. Pick your hero; swipe to move, JUMP and THROW.

title: The Pink Taco Twins vs. the Scissor Sisters
desc: Adults only, 18+. Crude cartoon party brawler: the Pink Taco Twins tag-team through 5 levels of Karens, mall cops and a murderous Roomba with queef blasts, boob bumps, motorboat mayhem and the scissor-leg headlock, then take down the Scissor Sisters. Swipe to move, swipe up to jump, tap the action buttons.
